title: Fix 6 AC is 'zero `grace` grep hits in demo code' but purge comments still contain 'a-grace'
evidence:
server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:618:    // Purged a-grace id -> a-grainne.
server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:724:    // Purged a-grace id -> a-grainne; doc ids kept stable.
client/test/demo/demo_flow_test.gleam:877:/// Fix 6: the a-grace residue is purged to the grainne id — the store serves
detail: The acceptance criterion (briefing + lens-guard) is literally 'zero `grace` grep hits in demo code'. A case-insensitive grep for 'grace' in client/src/demo, client/test/demo, and server/src/demo still returns these 4 comment hits. Functionally the id purge is complete (identifiers, fixtures, PDF filename all renamed), but the grep-based AC does not pass as written and a verifier re-running the grep will see residue.
recommended_fix: Reword the comments to avoid the old id (e.g. '// Purged legacy id -> a-grainne.' / '/// the old residue is purged to the grainne id'), so grep -ri grace over demo code returns zero hits.
